contract.headline: No authority layer is fully delayed — every measured layer contains at least one path with no established delay. Delays of 4h, 24h, 72h and 7d are measured on OTHER paths inside those same layers, and do not bound the undelayed ones.
contract.headline_basis: Derived from the layer rows below, not authored here, so it changes when the walk changes.

role_admin.via: ADMIN_ROLE 0 administers roles 21-25 and the manager's own target config
role_admin.note: Measured 2026-09-10. getRoleAdmin(21..25) is all 0, so the ADMIN Safe can re-point the vault's own upgrade gate. Three routes, and none is immediate: setTargetFunctionRole(vault, upgradeToAndCall, 0) is ADMIN-restricted with an operation delay of getTargetAdminDelay(vault) = 259200s, so it must be scheduled 72h ahead, after which a role-0 member upgrades with no further delay; grantRole(24, self, 0) is immediate to call but getRoleGrantDelay(24) = 604800s sets membership `since` 7 days out; setTargetAdminDelay(vault, 0) takes effect only after minSetback = 432000s (5 days). 72h is therefore the SHORTEST path by which the ADMIN Safe reaches the apyUSD vault, which is the same 72h the MAINTAINER Safe already faces. The 72h on this layer is NOT bypassable for the vault; it is bypassed only for the receipt contract.

paths.name: Apyx MAINTAINER Safe

paths.name: Apyx ADMIN Safe
paths.reach_bound: the UnlockReceipt contract only; the apyUSD vault and apxUSD are not reachable by this path
paths.hand_walk: RE-DERIVED 2026-09-10 at block 25,940,933; the earlier basis ("its upgrade selector maps to role 0 with zero delay") is WITHDRAWN as a non-discriminating read — getTargetFunctionRole returns 0 for every selector on this proxy AND for fabricated selector 0xdeadbeef AND for 0x...dEaD, which has no code. What discriminates: authority() on receipt proxy 0x9bf51f33955ec70f87c4b5c49441815589043237 returns this AccessManager, where 0x...dEaD errors (no code) and the unmanaged apxUSD implementation 0xdd71fd677fde2ed2579a3c45204f41a11016ccb4 returns 0x0. Its ERC-1967 slot holds verified implementation 0x54f1c7ffe10bc392f08ae9432a7e21a6e86bb982, whose _authorizeUpgrade carries OpenZeppelin's `restricted` modifier, so the manager is a real gate and roleId 0 means ADMIN_ROLE members only, not "ungated". hasRole(0, ADMIN Safe) is true with execution delay 0, while the MAINTAINER Safe, 0x...dEaD and 0x...0001 are all false — that read discriminates on the holder axis. The membership is an explicit grant, not a default: getAccess(0, ADMIN Safe) returns since=1774281275 (2026-03-23T15:54:35Z), and the manager's verified source writes `since` only in _grantRole, with hasRole special-casing PUBLIC_ROLE but NOT ADMIN_ROLE. getRoleGrantDelay(0)=604800 is a GRANT delay, not an execution delay, and is not recorded as a timelock. REACH IS BOUNDED TO THE RECEIPT: getTargetFunctionRole(apyUSD vault, upgradeToAndCall) is 24 and hasRole(24, ADMIN Safe) is false, so this zero-delay path does not reach the vault or apxUSD. The ADMIN Safe does reach the vault, but only through the manager's own admin surface at 72h — recorded on this layer as role_admin, not here, because it is a different path with a different delay.

paths.name: Apyx ADMIN Safe
paths.hand_walk: RE-DERIVED 2026-09-10 at block 25,940,933. The earlier basis is WITHDRAWN on both halves: "tested restricted selectors map to root role 0" does not discriminate (0x...dEaD with a fabricated selector returns the same 0), and "the receipt target-admin delay is zero" is the wrong quantity as well as non-discriminating — getTargetAdminDelay delays manager admin operations on a target, not restricted calls, and it returns 0 for 0x...dEaD too. What stands: pause() 0x8456cb59 and unpause() 0x3f4ba83a both carry `restricted` in verified implementation 0x54f1c7ffe10bc392f08ae9432a7e21a6e86bb982, the proxy's authority() is this AccessManager, and hasRole(0, ADMIN Safe) is true with execution delay 0 against false for the MAINTAINER Safe and for 0x...dEaD. The vault and receipt were both unpaused at the pinned block, and verified code makes pause block mint and claim with no holder emergency-exit bypass. Reach is the receipt; pause on the apyUSD vault itself is role 21, which the ADMIN Safe does not hold.
